notes: Family keys are the tier labels from the routing policy; values are provider/model ids in OpenCode's provider/model form.

The shipped ids name one provider (opencode-go) as an editorial default so every generated role renders out of the box; they were transcribed from an OpenCode 1.18.29 model list and are configured, not verified. OpenCode is provider-neutral: rebind all four to the provider you have configured and consented to.
A null value is legal and means unresolved; the doctor reports it as UNKNOWN, the renderer skips the roles that need it, and nothing substitutes a default.
After changing an id, regenerate roles with: python harness/tools/native_routing.py render
